title: pallas
text: Get latest stable R release CRAN. install pallas GitHub remotes: can use map_endpoint() take information SPARQL terms, namely classes predicates, defined given endpoint. map_endpoint() takes URL endpoint input returns object OWL S7 class. OWL objects contain Web Ontology Language (OWL). typical SPARQL query consists least three parts: prefix declarations query type (SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE) arguments clause also reflected OWL class:
code: install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("minotau-R/pallas") library(pallas) endpoint_url <- "https://sparql.uniprot.org/" x <- map_endpoint(endpoint_url) #> adding rname '5e918bfe31a47685419ba31861ec8b48ec502dbd71a767e0b138d60c40148804' x #> pallas::OWL list S7_object. #> $prefix #> [1] "PREFIX core: <http://purl.uniprot.org/core/>" #> [2] "PREFIX x01: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/>"     #>  #> $query #> list() #>  #> $where #> list() #> No 'query' found. Add and define a query with `add_query()`. #> No 'where' found. Add where-clauses with `where_clause()`.
